comment: Set Root Directory to 'app' in the Vercel project settings. The git repo
root is the handoff bundle, and the app is one level down, so a deploy from
the repo root finds no package.json.
Do NOT set BASE_PATH here. It exists for GitHub Pages, which serves the site
from /<repo>/; Vercel serves from the domain root and vite.config.js already
The rewrite below is what GitHub Pages cannot do: a deep link such as
/class/cls-5 is answered with the app shell and a 200, rather than the
404.html fallback and a 404 status. Vercel checks the filesystem before
applying rewrites, so the hashed files under /assets still serve as
